threadDescriptions.cello-neck: Restore the slipped neck joint on Leena's cello.
threadDescriptions.loan-cello: Arrange a temporary cello for Leena's concert while hers is repaired.
threadDescriptions.bow-rehair: Rehair Tomas's bow and obtain his approval of the tension.
threadDescriptions.studio-lock: Replace and distribute keys for the workshop door lock.

items.text: Leena's cello: neck projection dropped during rehearsal. Photograph the heel gap before loosening strings; no glue until the joint is inspected.
items.rationale: Documents the repair object and symptom.

items.text: Tomas asked for black hair on his spare bow, normal length. He'll collect after Saturday's lesson.
items.rationale: Defines a different customer's bow work.

items.text: Door cylinder sticks even with the spare key. Ordered a replacement keyed alike to three fresh keys.
items.rationale: Begins workshop lock replacement.

items.text: Leena needs a loan cello for Friday's concert. Call the cooperative about their full-size instrument and check whether a hard case is included.
items.rationale: Starts temporary instrument arrangement for Leena.

items.text: Heel gap close-up: old hide glue crumbled out dry. Mortise edges intact; neck reset estimate two bench days.
items.rationale: Examines the failed cello joint.

items.text: Co-op reply: full-size loan cello available Thursday afternoon, deposit £90. Leena must sign it out herself.
items.rationale: Specifies loan terms.

items.text: Tomas's frog slide is stubborn. Protect the pearl while opening it for the rehair; keep the removed knot in the job tray.
items.rationale: Preparation on Tomas's bow.

items.text: '90 by Thursday; ask L.' on torn masking tape.
items.rationale: Too abbreviated to distinguish a money amount, measurement or appointment.

items.text: Measured Leena's neck dry-fit again: three bench days, not two, because the button needs reinforcement. Concert deadline will not be met.
items.rationale: Revises duration based on additional repair work.

items.text: Key blanks arrived wrong profile. Locksmith will bring the proper cylinder and matching keys together Tuesday.
items.rationale: Updates replacement lock procurement.

items.text: Leena repair/loan call: neck reinforcement needs until Monday. Extend the co-op cello booking through Monday evening and set its bridge curve close to her usual setup so the Friday programme is playable.
items.rationale: Repair completion schedule and actionable loan extension both appear.

items.text: Bow rehair test for Tomas: at playing tension the ribbon is even, but two loose hairs need trimming near the tip.
items.rationale: Tests the rehaired bow.

items.text: Loan cello receipt, Leena: Thursday 15:30 to Monday 18:00, case included. Photograph existing scuff on lower rib at pickup.
items.rationale: Documents amended loan and condition at collection.

items.text: Leena neck joint clamped cleanly. Pencil line shows no movement after initial tension; leave overnight before final setup.
items.rationale: Progress on original cello restoration.

items.text: Workshop cylinder now turns freely. One new key to the cleaner, one to me, one in the sealed spare envelope.
items.rationale: Installation and distribution of replacement keys.

items.text: Tomas prefers slightly firmer tension than the first trial. Re-seat the knot rather than shorten hair at the frog.
items.rationale: Customer feedback modifies rehair.

items.text: Leena played her repaired cello for twenty minutes. Projection stable; invoice should include the button reinforcement.
items.rationale: Final repair test and billing detail.

items.text: Bench note without object: 'leave overnight; tiny movement?'
items.rationale: No reliable identity for the item being monitored.

items.text: Co-op accepted Leena's loan cello back Monday, matching pickup photos. Deposit released.
items.rationale: Closes temporary cello arrangement.

items.text: Tomas collected the bow after trying the firmer setup. Keep the black-hair preference on his job card.
items.rationale: Closes bow work.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: receipt and pickup scuff concern the temporary cello, not the neck restoration.
